_comment: Ratchet for scripts/i18n-tools/ui-label-audit.test.ts. defects: {key: [problems() reason stems]} known in messages/<loc>.json; variants: {short English label: why it may have >1 translation}. A new defect or variant fails the test, and so does an entry that no longer occurs: run `node scripts/i18n-tools/ui-label-audit.mjs all --prune` after fixing. A locale audit ends with its defects empty and every variant given a reason.

variants.share card: both are buttons: lab_report_card is the Lab notebook toolbar button that downloads a shareable image (Notebook.svelte, beside 'Lab report'), so it names the artifact — Карточка для публикации; card_share_card is the collector card's share action — Поделиться карточкой
variants.contact: different senses: privacy_contact_heading is the "Contact" heading of the privacy page (how to reach us); hud_contact is the descent HUD beat when a lander first touches the surface
variants.low: agreement with different nouns: hotspots_mode_* qualify the hotspot detail level (детализация, f.), quality_tier_* qualify the graphics quality (качество, n.) — низкая / низкое / высокая / высокое
variants.high: agreement with different nouns: hotspots_mode_* qualify the hotspot detail level (детализация, f.), quality_tier_* qualify the graphics quality (качество, n.) — низкая / низкое / высокая / высокое

notes.plan_destination_psyche: left "Psyche": problems() refuses the native Психея because it reads Psyche as the spacecraft; ja/ko/zh-CN have the native asteroid name
